summary.intent: Ship phase 77 (crypto-hygiene-and-terminology-canonicalization) of the CipherBox project by triaging CodeRabbit feedback, opening the PR, and running the GSD extract-learnings workflow to capture institutional knowledge from the completed phase.
summary.outcome: PR #609 was created and pushed with a full body (56 commits), CI began running (lint-pr-title and Verify E2E passed; Release Preview/Greptile/CodeRabbit pending), and a delegated sub-agent extracted phase 77 learnings (5 decisions / 6 lessons / 5 patterns / 4 surprises) into 77-LEARNINGS.md. The learnings commit + rebase to reconcile any bot `chore(release)` commit was in progress when the transcript ends.

repo: PR title must be conventional-commit style and paren-free for the lint-pr-title CI check to pass.
gh pr create's body arg isn't reliable for full PR descriptions in this repo's workflow — the body is set afterward via `gh api` PATCH on the PR.

CodeRabbit nitpicks on this repo frequently include false positives worth discarding: test-only zeroization suggestions, a canonical-codec micro-opt that would risk byte parity, a false positive on a hex-string field, and a premature STATE.md cursor bump.
workflow: extract-learnings (GSD workflow) requires PLAN.md + SUMMARY.md and optionally reads VERIFICATION.md/UAT.md/STATE.md, then writes {phase}-LEARNINGS.md with YAML frontmatter counting decisions/lessons/patterns/surprises; re-running it overwrites rather than appends.
Delegating learnings synthesis to a sub-agent keeps the orchestrator's context lean while large phase artifacts are digested.

Background CI/PR-review polling and learnings extraction can be run concurrently — kick off the slow review step, then do extract-learnings while waiting, and use ScheduleWakeup to resume once both progress.
Before committing a post-CI artifact (like LEARNINGS.md), fetch+rebase first in case a bot has landed a `chore(release)` commit in the interim, to avoid a divergent push.

friction: Sandbox had to be disabled to push the phase branch.
CI checks (Release Preview, Greptile, CodeRabbit PR-level review) took minutes to complete, requiring background polling and a scheduled wakeup rather than a synchronous wait.
Uncertainty around whether a bot `chore(release)` commit would land before the learnings commit, requiring a defensive rebase step.
open_items: CodeRabbit/Greptile PR-level review resolution on PR #609 was not yet handled — deferred until CI finishes.
Learnings commit (77-LEARNINGS.md) had not been pushed yet at transcript end; rebase-and-push step was in progress.
SHARE-WRITE-KEY gap (write-share key threading) remains open per existing project memory, unrelated to this session's direct work but still outstanding in the codebase.
